findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 1, Harm 2
Raise: Test.
Case: normal use - CI checks a freshly initialized Python starter.
The Python expression only matches `define_prompt(`, but the sole production definition is `def define_prompt[InputT: BaseModel](` in app/core/prompts.py:31. Production contains no matching calls, so git grep returns 1 and the assertion on line 162 always fails, including before live checks run. Recognize the generic function declaration separately while retaining the check against default prompt registrations.

findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 2, Harm 2
Raise: Not done.
Case: normal use - a developer builds a feature with `--field 'status:status(active)'`.
The feature command accepts a single status value (src/forge/feature.py:53), and its Python generator emits a single-value Literal (src/forge/feature_python.py:313). [Pydantic emits `const` for that schema](https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic/blob/main/pydantic/json_schema.py), whereas this branch recognizes only `enum`. Consequently, the guide omits allowed_values and values_uri, no status-value resource is listed, and reading its address fails. Normalize `const` into a one-element allowed-value list as well.
